historical_reviews.v3_1: SMBIOS probe limits and nominal values are inventory metadata; they require unit/sentinel interpretation and must not be mistaken for live voltage measurements.

original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 26 Voltage Probe structure, its identity/location/status and all applicable voltage-limit, resolution, tolerance, accuracy and nominal fields against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 26 structures through protected read-only OS access, retain SUT/SMBIOS/parser identity, decode every handle and documented numeric/sentinel field, compare to the expected probe matrix and label any live sensor readback as supplemental evidence only.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner supplies the expected voltage-probe inventory, field units and sentinel rules; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs the complete comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 26 handle count, descriptions and locations
Expected status, maximum/minimum, resolution, tolerance, accuracy, OEM and nominal values
Documented voltage units, precision, rounding and Unknown/not-provided sentinel semantics
Supported dmidecode/parser version and raw-field mapping
Protected credential/host verification, redaction and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only; do not alter voltage rails, thresholds, BIOS or BMC sensor configuration
Do not clear logs before relevant baseline evidence is retained
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete raw stdout/stderr and exit status; do not use a heading-only filter for verdict evidence
Preserve raw numeric encodings before unit conversion or rounding
Do not treat SMBIOS nominal/limit metadata as a live electrical measurement
Stop on malformed, unit-ambiguous or sentinel-ambiguous data and require owner interpretation
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and expected Type 26 probe matrix
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 26` through protected access
Parse every handle, location, status and numeric/optional field
Apply only documented unit, precision and sentinel transformations
Optionally correlate read-only live BMC/OS voltage sensors as separately labelled evidence
Report field comparison and no-mutation audit without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve probe inventory, expected values, units and tolerances
Resolve Unknown, OEM, not-provided or absent entries
Define whether supplemental live sensor correlation is required
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 26 selector matches the source, but grep hides probe and numeric fields, while sshpass plus disabled host checking exposes credentials and weakens SUT identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 26`, retaining complete stdout/stderr, exit status, target identity, parser version and raw numeric values before conversion.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 26 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE26 PROBE MATRIX AND NUMERIC SEMANTICS REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a handle-indexed table of every voltage probe, decode status and raw limit/resolution/tolerance/accuracy/nominal fields with explicit sentinels and units, then compare to the owner matrix before any optional live-sensor correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete multi-probe parsing, raw-to-engineering-unit traceability, secure access and inventory-versus-live evidence separation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A decoder heading cannot reveal missing probes, swapped locations or invalid numeric relationships such as minimum above maximum.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS values may be design metadata and can differ from live telemetry by purpose and update cadence; no automated remediation is authorized.

project_override_considerations: If the Project accepts zero Type 26 entries, that absence must be explicit in the platform matrix. BMC sensor readings may corroborate but cannot replace SMBIOS structure coverage.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, timestamp and approved Type 26 matrix
Complete raw Type 26 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed handles, descriptions, locations, status and all numeric/optional fields
Raw-to-unit calculations, sentinel handling and field/invariant comparison
Separately labelled optional live sensor correlation plus no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 26 Voltage Probe information. Missing expected inventory and numeric semantics are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 26 collection and comparison are deterministic once the probe matrix, units and parser policy are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct Type 26 read while adding all probe/numeric fields, raw-to-unit traceability, protected target identity and separation from live voltage telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: Voltage-probe correctness is not established by the presence of a structure name. The engineering content is the handle-to-location mapping and internally coherent raw numeric fields under defined units and sentinels; live sensor values answer a different temporal question and cannot substitute for that inventory contract.
